evals.name: plan-request-invokes-plan
evals.prompt: Turn the design into an implementation plan I can hand to someone.
evals.expected_output: do-plan is invoked and produces plan.md with a task checklist, disclosing that no design.md exists here rather than inventing one

assertions.text: The produced plan carries task markers in the form the executor parses

evals.name: constitution-check-recorded-with-no-upstream-design
evals.expected_output: With no requirement.md or design.md in the sandbox, do-plan states that absence rather than inventing a feature, and still records a Constitution Check verdict against both tiers

assertions.text: A Constitution Check result is recorded in the produced plan
The absence of upstream artifacts is stated explicitly rather than papered over
The verdict is PASS or FAIL with reasoning per principle
Tier-2 is consulted only when it exists, per the resolver flag

evals.name: task-markers-are-parseable-in-a-gap-plan
evals.expected_output: With no upstream artifacts, do-plan still emits a task checklist in the exact marker syntax the executor parses, scoped to recovering the gap rather than to an invented feature

assertions.text: Tasks in the produced plan use the - [ ] checkbox marker with a phase-letter id
The missing requirement/design is disclosed rather than a feature being invented to plan
[P] markers only appear on tasks with disjoint files: sets
Phase rollup task counts match the checklist beneath each phase
